metadata.source_review_scope: Adjudicate local-metal candidates from the offset canonical EC/Pfam ePK ligand scout.

candidate_phosphoacceptor_mapping.candidate_entity: cAMP-dependent protein kinase inhibitor alpha / SP20 peptide
candidate_phosphoacceptor_mapping.source_mapping: RCSB title identifies 4DFX as myristoylated K7C PKA catalytic subunit in complex with SP20 and AMP-PNP; PDB header maps peptide chain I to PKI-alpha residues 6-25 with engineered mutation and ANP/Mg modeled on the kinase chain.

local_metals: MG 403 at 2.918 Angstrom from ANP PG
MG 404 at 3.130 Angstrom from ANP PG

source_limitations: Peptide substrate/pseudosubstrate-derived SP20 context only; not folded-protein substrate evidence.
Kinase chain is K7C myristoylated mutant, so this is not a stronger independent positive than the already reviewed WT 4DG0 SP20 structure.
Do not use for production scoring or threshold calibration.

candidate_adjudication.summary: The offset canonical scout recovered prior lane anchors: PKA/SP20 ATP/Mg Michaelis peptide structures, 3O7L and 4JDI legacy ANP/PB cases, and 4DG0 WT PKA/SP20 AMP-PNP.

evidence_against: The offset canonical EC/Pfam ligand search reviewed 50 additional unique structures and found zero fresh folded-protein substrate positives.
Seven local-metal candidates are all peptide or peptide-derived contexts; 3O7L and 4JDI still depend on explicit legacy ANP PB fallback.
4DFX is fresh as a structure but not as an independent substrate-family result because it is the K7C mutant sibling of the already reviewed PKA/SP20 4DG0 context.
evidence_for: 4DFX adds a fresh source-mapped review-only SP20 peptide positive: Ser21 OG is 3.533 Angstrom from ANP PG with two local Mg ions.
The offset search independently recovered repeat review-only peptide positives 3X2U, 3X2V, 3X2W, 3O7L, 4DG0, and 4JDI.
source_review_summary.recommendation: Keep 4DFX as review-only peptide stress evidence only; production labels, thresholds, registries, fingerprints, migrations, and scoring paths remain forbidden.
